definition: each part's protein and nucleic acid as the closed surface that holds its own volume (0.135 nm³ for each amino acid, 0.32 nm³ for each nucleotide) in a cloud where each residue is spread as a Gaussian 1.6 nm wide, on a grid 1.6 nm apart
illustration: The viewer's own surface of the entry's coordinates, an illustration: not the structure, and nothing of the entry is copied but the numbers worked out here. The Protein Data Bank states no surface.
title: Structure of the Bacterial Ribosome at 2 Angstrom Resolution
frame: the measuring tool's two-subunit frame: origin at the centre of both subunits' atoms; y from the large subunit's centre to the small one's; x the whole particle's longest axis made square to y; z = x × y
